correctness.rationale: For deterministic complete tripartite K_{n,n,k}, n>=16k, uniform among currently feasible edges, exact state (a,b,c)=(m-x,m-y,k-x-y). At AB level m>=4k, a fixed unmatched C vertex meets the first edge with probability (a+b)/(ab+c(a+b))>=1/m; successive-level survival telescopes to <=M/n, hence all C vertices absorbed above M with failure probability <=kM/n. At each rare edge, A/B endpoint conditional probability a/(a+b) differs from 1/2 by <=k/[4(M-k)], coupled across <=k choices, giving <=k^2/[4(M-k)] mismatch. If all rare vertices matched, final dense imbalance exactly |k-2X|. Therefore TV bound kM/n+k^2/[4(M-k)], M=ceil(sqrt(kn)), and convergence for k=o(n^(1/3)); conditional binomial CLT gives folded-normal scaled law. Maximum matching leaves k mod 2 vertices (given n>=k), so p_odd=2^(1-k)binom(k,(k-1)/2), p_even=2^-k binom(k,k/2). Independent exact-rational state DP checked 104 n/k cases and representative TV bounds, not an infinite proof.
